items.title: Experiment arm context resolver (experimentId override) as a new core leaf
items.context: New core module (e.g. packages/main/src/core/experiment-arm.ts): resolveExperimentArm(root) returning {experimentId, arm: control|treatment} | null. Source of truth: explicit opt-in context (env vars e.g. LATTICE_EXPERIMENT_ID + LATTICE_EXPERIMENT_ARM, or an arm-context file under .lattice/experiments/experience-ablation/<experimentId>/ — choose in PLAN and record in decision). When null (no experiment active) behavior everywhere is byte-identical to today. When set, it overrides resolveHintMode for pack/hint gating. Pure function, no I/O beyond reading the context; unit-testable.
items.userSees: A logic test prints: no context -> null; context set -> {experimentId, arm} parsed and validated; invalid arm value -> explicit error naming the accepted values

happy.desc: Both env vars set with valid values returns {experimentId, arm}

edge.desc: No vars -> null (no-experiment mode); exactly one var set -> null plus a warning naming the ignored var

adversarial.desc: Invalid arm value (e.g. treatmnt) rejected/ignored with an explicit message naming accepted values control|treatment; empty experimentId treated as unset

verificationEvidence.note: Both env vars valid (control and treatment) resolve to {experimentId, arm} with whitespace trimmed and no warning; neither set resolves to silent null (production mode). 11/11 checks pass.

Partial context (id only / arm only / whitespace-only counterpart) returns null with exactly one console.warn naming the ignored var; empty or whitespace-only experimentId is treated as unset (silent null when arm also unset).

Invalid arm value (e.g. uppercase CONTROL) returns null with one warning naming accepted values control|treatment; module-level once-latch proves repeated misconfigured resolutions warn exactly once per process (resetExperimentArmWarnLatch test hook).

items.title: Full-pack render gate applied at all seven lifecycle entrypoints via one shared leaf
items.context: Extend the surfaceExperienceHints pattern to the full MemoryFreshnessPack: a shared leaf (e.g. core/experience-pack-surface.ts) that computes the pack (buildMemoryFreshnessPack) and ALWAYS logs an experience_pack_surfaced activity event with {experimentId, arm, consumer, packDigest, topHitIds} on both arms, but returns renderedSection only on treatment (or when no experiment is active, current behavior unchanged). Wire the seven call sites (story-create, transition-orchestrator, session, lattice-handoff, done-prepare, done-closure, dev-memory) through this leaf. The arm must never affect issues/blockers, gate decisions, or resolveReviewPromptHash. authority=non_authoritative and gateEvidence=false must render unchanged on treatment.
items.userSees: With arm=control any lifecycle command prints no Memory Runtime Preflight section but the activity log gains an experience_pack_surfaced event with arm=control and the full would-have-surfaced pack digest; with arm=treatment output is byte-identical to no-experiment mode plus the same event with arm=treatment

happy.desc: With arm=treatment each entrypoint renders the pack section exactly as no-experiment mode AND appends experience_pack_surfaced {experimentId, arm:treatment, consumer, packDigest}
With arm=control each entrypoint renders NO pack section AND appends experience_pack_surfaced {arm:control} with the full would-have-surfaced digest

edge.desc: No-experiment mode output byte-identical to pre-change behavior at all seven entrypoints (regression guard)
done-prepare summary render shape (renderMemoryFreshnessPackSummary via runbook.pack) gated identically to the six full-render sites

adversarial.desc: Arm never alters resolveReviewPromptHash or any gate/blocker output (byte-compare across arms)
Event dedup: repeated same-consumer calls in one round append exactly one experience_pack_surfaced event

items.title: Mechanical control-arm retrieval blocking at the CLI choke point with recorded violations
items.context: In cli-engine.ts alongside enforceStoryOwnerLeaseGate (~line 950), add an experiment-arm gate: when resolveExperimentArm yields arm=control, commands classified as memory retrieval/consumption (recall, dev_memory_*, playbook_*, learning_scan/learning_validate/learning_effectiveness, memory_playbook_baseline_*) are refused with a clear error naming the experiment context, and EVERY attempt appends a structured retrieval_violation event (experimentId, command, timestamp) to the activity log so the M4 scorer can count retrievalViolationCount (plan section 10 score schema). Treatment arm and no-experiment mode are unaffected. The block list is a declared constant next to the command catalog classification, not string guessing.
items.userSees: With arm=control, lattice recall ... exits nonzero printing blocked: memory retrieval is disabled on the control arm of experiment <id>, and the activity log shows a retrieval_violation event; with no experiment context the same command works normally

happy.desc: With arm=control, lattice recall exits nonzero with the block message naming the experimentId, and a retrieval_violation event {experimentId, command} is appended

edge.desc: With arm=treatment and with no experiment context the same retrieval commands work normally (no block, no violation event)

adversarial.desc: Catalog cross-check: every command whose name matches the memory families (recall, dev_memory_*, playbook_*, learning_*, memory_playbook_baseline_*) carries the retrieval-block marker; an unmarked family member fails the smoke

verificationEvidence.note: Control arm: recall exits 1 printing blocked: memory retrieval is disabled on the control arm of experiment exp-m3-manual; .lattice/activity.jsonl gains {event:retrieval_violation, experimentId:exp-m3-manual, command:recall, timestamp} appended BEFORE the refusal. Write-side dev_memory_capture equally blocked with its own event (store writes forbidden during runs).

verificationEvidence.note: Treatment arm: recall exits 0 with normal ranked output; no-experiment mode: recall exits 0; control arm + non-memory command (story_list) exits 0. Activity log retrieval_violation event count unchanged across all three runs (no false violations).

Catalog cross-check ALL PASS: every MAIN_TOOLS/COMMAND_POLICIES command matching the declared MEMORY_RETRIEVAL_COMMAND_FAMILIES (recall, dev_memory_*, playbook_*, learning_scan/validate/effectiveness, memory_playbook_baseline_*) carries memoryRetrieval:true (28 commands, both directions, strict boolean check); non-family sentinels (story_list, memory_benchmark_run) unmarked; gate unit checks cover control block+event, treatment/no-env pass, invalid arm treated as no experiment.

items.title: Store-root resolution surface for isolation assertions
items.context: M4 score records must assert every arm-run resolved learning root is the isolated experiment root, never the shared main-repo .lattice/learning (plan section 12). Add a small read-only surface: expose the resolved learning root (learning-store.ts resolveLearningDir) via an inspectable command or JSON field (e.g. lattice observability_snapshot gains resolvedLearningRoot, or a learning_root flag on an existing read-only command — choose in PLAN). No behavior change to resolution itself; this is the mechanical assertion hook the runner and scorer consume.
items.userSees: Running the chosen read-only command inside a temp non-git root prints resolvedLearningRoot pointing at that temp root; running it in the main repo prints the main-repo .lattice/learning path

happy.desc: lattice observability_snapshot (or the chosen read-only surface) in the main repo prints resolvedLearningRoot ending .lattice/learning under the main-repo root

edge.desc: Same command inside a fresh non-git temp root prints resolvedLearningRoot under that temp root (isolation-visible)

adversarial.desc: The surface is read-only: adding it changes no resolution behavior — resolveLearningRoot call sites and outputs unchanged (logic test compares resolution results before/after wiring)

verificationEvidence.note: Text output includes: resolvedLearningRoot: /Users/jek/Documents/Work/proofbound/.lattice/learning — ends in /.lattice/learning under the MAIN repo root while cwd is the linked worktree (canonicalization visible).
Fresh mkdtemp non-git dir obs-root-7uYg7s: both text and JSON print resolvedLearningRoot = <tempRoot>/.lattice/learning, i.e. under the temp root itself, not the shared main-repo store.

Test asserts handler field is byte-equal to existing resolveLearningDir(root) (delegation, no re-implementation). Resolution call sites unchanged: git diff main...HEAD -- packages/main/src/core/learning-store.ts is empty (0 lines); existing observability-snapshot-smoke still passes.
